# Acme Search

Search Acme's product documentation.

## Install

**Claude Code**
```
/plugin marketplace add acme/acme-plugin-marketplace
/plugin install acme-search@acme-plugin-marketplace
```

**Codex**
```
codex plugin marketplace add acme/acme-plugin-marketplace
```

## Server

- **Endpoint:** `https://search.mcp.acme.example/mcp`
- **Transport:** `http`
- **Auth:** `none`
- **Tags:** search, docs
- **Homepage:** https://acme.example.com
